ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Suspicious PowerShell Keywords
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potentially suspicious keywords that could indicate the use of a PowerShell exploitation framework Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*System\\\.Reflection\\\.Assembly\\\.Load\\(\\$.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\[System\\\.Reflection\\\.Assembly\\]\\:\\:Load\\(\\$.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\[Reflection\\\.Assembly\\]\\:\\:Load\\(\\$.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*System\\\.Reflection\\\.AssemblyName.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Reflection\\\.Emit\\\.AssemblyBuilderAccess.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Reflection\\\.Emit\\\.CustomAttributeBuilder.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Runtime\\\.InteropServices\\\.UnmanagedType.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Runtime\\\.InteropServices\\\.DllImportAttribute.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*SuspendThread.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*rundll32.*"))
